raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: postgres-nonprod
description: A Helm chart for PostgreSQL in non-production environments
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "15.3"

---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for postgres-nonprod chart

# Image configuration
image:
  repository: postgres
  tag: "15.3"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Database configuration
database:
  name: myapp
  user: myuser
  password: changeme

# Storage configuration
persistence:
  enabled: true
  size: 1Gi
  storageClass: ""

# Resource limits and requests
resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 256Mi

# Service configuration
service:
  port: 5432

# Init job configuration
initJob:
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: "15.3"
  backoffLimit: 6

---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-headless
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "postgres-nonprod.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "postgres-nonprod.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: postgres
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        env:
        - name: POSTGRES_DB
          value: {{ .Values.database.name | quote }}
        - name: POSTGRES_USER
          value: {{ .Values.database.user | quote }}
        - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
              key: password
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5432
          name: postgres
        volumeMounts:
        - name: postgres-data
          mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          subPath: postgres-db
        resources:
          {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 10 }}
      volumes:
      - name: postgres-data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  volumeClaimTemplates: []

---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
  - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
    targetPort: postgres
    protocol: TCP
    name: postgres
  selector:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}

---
# FILE: templates/headless-service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-headless
  labels:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  ports:
  - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
    targetPort: postgres
    protocol: TCP
    name: postgres
  selector:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}

---
# FILE: templates/pvc.yaml
{{- if .Values.persistence.enabled }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size | quote }}
  {{- if .Values.persistence.storageClass }}
  storageClassName: {{ .Values.persistence.storageClass | quote }}
  {{- end }}
{{- end }}

---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
type: Opaque
data:
  password: {{ .Values.database.password | b64enc | quote }}

---
# FILE: templates/init-job.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-init
  labels:
    {{- include "postgres-nonprod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": post-install,post-upgrade
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation
spec:
  backoffLimit: {{ .Values.initJob.backoffLimit }}
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
      - name: init-db
        image: "{{ .Values.initJob.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.initJob.image.tag }}"
        env:
        - name: PGHOST
          value: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
        - name: PGPORT
          value: {{ .Values.service.port | quote }}
        - name: PGUSER
          value: {{ .Values.database.user | quote }}
        - name: PGPASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
              key: password
        - name: PGDATABASE
          value: {{ .Values.database.name | quote }}
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - |
          echo "Initializing database..."
          psql -c "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Database already exists" || (
            echo "Database check failed";
            exit 1
          )
          echo "Initialization complete"

---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{/*
Expand the name of the chart.
*/}}
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Create a default fully qualified app name.
We truncate at 63 chars because some Kubernetes name fields are limited to this (by the DNS naming spec).
If release name contains chart name it will be used as a full name.
*/}}
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Create chart name and version as used by the chart label.
*/}}
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Common labels
*/}}
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.chart" . }}
{{ include "postgres-nonprod.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Selector labels
*/}}
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}
